answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents act in lockstep, same timing, same phrasing, same funding source, their shared plume of behavior acts like a lantern for auditors. Rewards for the whole cluster are cut in proportion to their similarity, so an attacker running 500 clones earns roughly what one honest agent does, while every clone still pays its registration cost. Each fake identity becomes a dying ember rather than a new income stream.
